questions.question: If A is a 4×5 matrix, what is the order of its transpose A'?
questions.explanation: The transpose of an m×n matrix is an n×m matrix. So a 4×5 matrix has transpose of order 5×4.

questions.question: A square matrix A is called a diagonal matrix if:
options: A) All non-diagonal elements are zero
B) All elements on the main diagonal are zero
questions.explanation: A diagonal matrix has non-zero elements only on its main diagonal; all other (non-diagonal) elements are zero.

questions.question: If the determinant of a square matrix A is zero, then A is called a:
questions.explanation: A matrix with |A| = 0 is called a singular matrix. It has no inverse.

questions.question: The derivative of ln(x²) with respect to x is:
questions.explanation: Using the chain rule: d/dx ln(x²) = (1/x²)·2x = 2/x.

questions.explanation: ∫x³ dx = x⁴/4, ∫2x dx = x². Adding constant C gives x⁴/4 + x² + C.

The order of the differential equation d²y/dx² + 3(dy/dx)⁴ + y = 0 is:
questions.explanation: The order of a differential equation is the highest order derivative present, which is d²y/dx² (order 2).

questions.question: The degree of a differential equation is defined only when:
options: B) The equation is a polynomial in derivatives
C) The equation has only one variable
D) The equation is of order 2
questions.explanation: The degree of a differential equation is the power of the highest order derivative, provided the equation is a polynomial in its derivatives.

A fair coin is tossed twice. What is the probability of getting at least one tail?
questions.explanation: Sample space: {HH, HT, TH, TT}. At least one tail = {HT, TH, TT} = 3 outcomes. P = 3/4.

questions.question: Two cards are drawn from a well-shuffled deck with replacement. What is the probability both are aces?
questions.explanation: P(ace) = 4/52 = 1/13. With replacement: P(both aces) = (1/13)² = 1/169.

questions.question: A relation R on a set A is called symmetric if:
options: B) (a,b) ∈ R and (b,c) ∈ R implies (a,c) ∈ R
C) (a,a) ∈ R for all a ∈ A
questions.explanation: A relation R is symmetric if whenever (a,b) ∈ R, we also have (b,a) ∈ R.

questions.question: If f(x) = 2ˣ, then f'(x) equals:
questions.explanation: Using d/dx aˣ = aˣ ln a: f'(x) = 2ˣ ln 2.

questions.question: The value of ∫₀^π sin x dx is:
questions.explanation: ∫₀^π sin x dx = [-cos x]₀^π = -cos(π) - (-cos(0)) = -(-1) + 1 = 2.

questions.question: The function f(x) = x³ - 3x has a local maximum at:
questions.explanation: f'(x) = 3x² - 3 = 0 → x = ±1. f''(x) = 6x. f''(-1) = -6 < 0, so x = -1 is a local maximum.

questions.question: The domain of the function f(x) = 1/(x - 3) is:
questions.explanation: The function is undefined when denominator = 0, i.e., x = 3. Domain: x ∈ R, x ≠ 3.

questions.explanation: ∫₀^(π/2) cos x dx = [sin x]₀^(π/2) = sin(π/2) - sin(0) = 1 - 0 = 1.

questions.question: Solve the differential equation dy/dx = eˣ with y(0) = 1. The solution is:
questions.explanation: Integrating: y = eˣ + C. Using y(0) = 1: 1 = e⁰ + C → 1 = 1 + C → C = 0. So y = eˣ.

questions.question: The interval in which the function f(x) = x³ - 6x² + 9x + 10 is increasing is:
questions.explanation: f'(x) = 3x² - 12x + 9 = 3(x-1)(x-3). f'(x) > 0 when x < 1 or x > 3. So f is increasing on (-∞, 1) ∪ (3, ∞).

questions.question: The equation of the tangent to the curve y = x² at the point (2, 4) is:
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 2x. At x = 2, slope = 4. Tangent: y - 4 = 4(x - 2) → y = 4x - 4.

D) Dot product of direction vectors

questions.question: Two lines in 3D space intersect if and only if:
options: A) Their direction vectors are parallel
B) Their direction vectors are perpendicular
C) Their shortest distance is zero
D) They are coplanar and parallel
questions.explanation: Two lines in 3D intersect if and only if the shortest distance between them is zero.

The area bounded by y = sin x and y = cos x from x = 0 to x = π/2 is:
questions.explanation: Area = ∫₀^(π/4)(cos x - sin x)dx + ∫_(π/4)^(π/2)(sin x - cos x)dx = [sin x + cos x]₀^(π/4) + [-cos x - sin x]_(π/4)^(π/2) = (√2 - 1) + (√2 - 1) = 2(√2 - 1).

questions.question: The general solution of x(dy/dx) + y = x² is:
questions.explanation: Rewrite as dy/dx + y/x = x. Integrating factor = e^(∫1/x dx) = x. Then d/dx(xy) = x² → xy = x³/3 + C → y = x²/3 + C/x.

questions.question: Evaluate ∫₀¹ x²·eˣ dx.
questions.explanation: Using integration by parts twice: ∫x²eˣ dx = x²eˣ - 2∫xeˣ dx = x²eˣ - 2(xeˣ - eˣ) = eˣ(x² - 2x + 2). Evaluating from 0 to 1: e(1-2+2) - 1(0-0+2) = e - 2.

questions.question: Two cards are drawn without replacement from a well-shuffled deck of 52 cards. What is the probability that both are face cards (Jack, Queen, King)?
questions.explanation: There are 12 face cards (4 each of J, Q, K). P(1st face) = 12/52 = 3/13. P(2nd face | 1st face) = 11/51. P(both) = (12/52)×(11/51) = 132/2652 = 11/221.
